```{r}
#| label: data-results
#| include: false

load(file = here("input/data/proc/df_final.RData"))

# Index of the three original subjective social status measures (own, family of
# origin and children), with its WE/BE decomposition. Used as a control in the
# models that include the trajectory slope.
df_study1 <- df_study1 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sss_index = rowMeans(across(c(ess, ess_og, ess_hijos)))) %>%
  group_by(idencuesta) %>%
  mutate(sss_index_mean = mean(sss_index, na.rm = TRUE),
         sss_index_cwc  = sss_index - sss_index_mean) %>%
  ungroup()

# Variables used in the models of the Modelling section and in the descriptive
# figures (plus the wave). Complete cases are required only in these variables, to keep
# as many observations as possible. People without a valid income trajectory are
# kept as the extra category "Missings".
vars_mod <- c("idencuesta", "ola", "mjp_index", "ola_num", "ola_2", "ideo", "sex", "age",
              "dummy_educ_mean", "traj_ingreso",
              "ess_og_cwc", "ess_og_mean", "ess_cwc", "ess_mean",
              "ess_hijos_cwc", "ess_hijos_mean",
              "mov_exp_og_cwc", "mov_exp_og_mean",
              # variables of the descriptive figures
              "ess", "ess_og", "ess_hijos",
              "mov_exp_og", "educ")

df_model <- df_study1 %>%
  select(all_of(vars_mod)) %>%
  mutate(traj_ingreso = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(traj_ingreso, level = "Missings")) %>%
  na.omit()

# N of observations and persons used in a figure -----------------------------

# single variable (or set of variables jointly non-missing)
n_note <- function(vars, data = df_model) {
  d <- data %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))
  paste0("N = ", format(nrow(d), big.mark = ","), " observations, ",
         format(n_distinct(d$idencuesta), big.mark = ","), " persons")
}

# correlation matrices (pairwise-complete): range of N across variable pairs
n_note_pw <- function(vars, data = df_cor_base) {
  d <- data %>% ungroup()
  n <- combn(vars, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    map(function(p) {
      dd <- d[complete.cases(d[, p]), ]
      c(obs = nrow(dd), per = n_distinct(dd$idencuesta))
    }) %>%
    do.call(rbind, .)
  rng <- function(x) {
    if (min(x) == max(x)) format(min(x), big.mark = ",")
    else paste0(format(min(x), big.mark = ","), "-", format(max(x), big.mark = ","))
  }
  paste0("N = ", rng(n[, "obs"]), " observations, ",
         rng(n[, "per"]), " persons")
}

# data of the i-th wave (waves are ordered 2016, ..., 2023)
wave_data <- function(i, data = df_cor_base) {
  data %>% ungroup() %>% filter(ola == sort(unique(ola))[i])
}
```

```{r}
#| label: auxiliar function

make_table <- function(models, col_names, blocks, extra_rows = list(), note = note_prev) {
  terms  <- unlist(lapply(blocks, `[[`, "terms"))
  labels <- unlist(lapply(blocks, `[[`, "labels"))
  idx    <- sapply(blocks, function(b) length(b$terms)); names(idx) <- sapply(blocks, `[[`, "name")

  coefs <- sapply(models, function(m) sapply(terms, function(t) cell(m, t)))
  rownames(coefs) <- labels

  fit_rows <- rbind(
    "N_i (observaciones)"            = sapply(models, nobs),
    "N_j (personas)"                 = sapply(models, function(m) ngrps(m)[["idencuesta"]]),
    "AIC"                            = sapply(models, function(m) fmt(AIC(m), 1)),
    "BIC"                            = sapply(models, function(m) fmt(BIC(m), 1)),
    "Var. intercepto (persona)"      = sapply(models, function(m) fmt(var_comp(m, "int"))),
    "Var. pendiente ola_num"         = sapply(models, function(m) fmt(var_comp(m, "time"))),
    "Var. pendiente aleatoria del WE interactuado" = sapply(models, function(m) {
                                          v <- var_comp(m, "sss"); ifelse(is.na(v), "", fmt(v, 4)) }),
    "Var. residual"                  = sapply(models, function(m) fmt(var_comp(m, "resid"))),
    "Ajuste singular"                = sapply(models, function(m) ifelse(isSingular(m), "sí", "no")),
    "Convergencia"                   = sapply(models, function(m)
                                          ifelse(is.null(m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages), "ok", "advertencia")))

  if (length(extra_rows)) {
    fit_rows <- rbind(fit_rows, do.call(rbind, lapply(extra_rows, unname)))
  }

  out <- rbind(coefs, fit_rows)
  colnames(out) <- col_names
  idx <- c(idx, "Ajuste y efectos aleatorios" = nrow(fit_rows))

  kable(out, format = "html", align = c("l", rep("r", length(models))),
        format.args = list(big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
    pack_rows(index = idx) %>%
    footnote(general = note, general_title = "Nota: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
}
```

# Descriptives

## Market Justice Preferences 

```{r}
#| label: fig-mjp-dist
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of the market justice preferences (MJP) index by wave"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| fig-align: center

df_mjp <- df_model %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(mjp_index)) %>%
  mutate(mjp_bin = cut(mjp_index, breaks = seq(1, 5, by = 0.5),
                       include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE))

df_mjp_mean <- df_mjp %>%
  group_by(ola) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(mjp_index), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lab = paste0("Mean = ", sprintf("%.2f", m)))

ggplot(df_mjp, aes(x = mjp_index)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count / tapply(count, PANEL, sum)[PANEL])),
                 breaks = seq(0.75, 5.25, by = 0.5), closed = "right",
                 fill = met.brewer("Hiroshige", 1, direction = -1)[1],
                 colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(data = df_mjp_mean, aes(xintercept = m),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey20") +
  geom_text(data = df_mjp_mean, aes(x = 5, y = Inf, label = lab),
            hjust = 1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  facet_wrap(~ ola, nrow = 2) +
  labs(x = "MJP index (1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree)", y = NULL,
       caption = "Bins of width 0.5 centred on 1, 1.5, ..., 5. Dashed line: wave mean.") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Static Social Subjective Status

```{r}
#| label: fig-ess-dist
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of subjective social status (own, family of origin and children) by wave"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-align: center

ess_labs <- c(ess = "Own", ess_og = "Family of origin", ess_hijos = "Children")

df_ess <- df_model %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ola, all_of(names(ess_labs))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ola, names_to = "var", values_to = "val") %>%
  filter(!is.na(val)) %>%
  mutate(var = factor(var, levels = names(ess_labs), labels = ess_labs)) %>%
  count(var, ola, val) %>%
  group_by(var, ola) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

df_ess_mean <- df_model %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ola, all_of(names(ess_labs))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ola, names_to = "var", values_to = "val") %>%
  mutate(var = factor(var, levels = names(ess_labs), labels = ess_labs)) %>%
  group_by(var, ola) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(df_ess, aes(x = val, y = prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = met.brewer("Hiroshige", 1, direction = -1)[1], width = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = df_ess_mean, aes(xintercept = m),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey20") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:10) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), n.breaks = 3) +
  facet_grid(ola ~ var) +
  labs(x = "Subjective social status (0 = lowest, 10 = highest)", y = NULL,
       caption = paste0("Dashed line: wave mean.\n", n_note(names(ess_labs)))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

- The Own SSS averages 4.4 (out of 10) and family-of-origin SSS 3.9, both below the scale midpoint; in contrast,  children’s SSS averages 6.4, the only one of the measures that is above the midpoint. 

- Wave means move little between waves: own between 4,18 and 4,64; origin between 3,67 and 4,12; son between 6,24 and 6,75

```{r}
    facet_wrap(~ ola, ncol = 3) +
    labs(title = mov_labs[[v]], x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

## Dinamic and Static Objective Social Status

```{r}
#| label: obj-dist-setup
#| include: false

obj_col <- met.brewer("Hiroshige", 1, direction = -1)[1]

theme_obj <- theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# categorical / dichotomous variables: proportion by wave
plot_obj_cat <- function(var, labs = NULL, xlab = NULL) {
  d <- df_model %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(ola, val = all_of(var)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(val)) %>%
    mutate(val = if (is.null(labs)) as.factor(val) else factor(val, levels = names(labs), labels = labs)) %>%
    count(ola, val) %>%
    group_by(ola) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(d, aes(x = val, y = prop)) +
    geom_col(fill = obj_col, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1)), vjust = -0.4, size = 4) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    facet_wrap(~ ola, ncol = 3) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL, caption = n_note(var)) +
    theme_obj +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}

# continuous variables: histogram by wave with wave mean
plot_obj_cont <- function(var, binwidth, xlab = NULL) {
  d <- df_model %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(ola, val = all_of(var)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(val))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = val)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth, fill = obj_col, colour = "white") +
    geom_vline(data = d %>% group_by(ola) %>% summarise(m = mean(val), .groups = "drop"),
               aes(xintercept = m), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~ ola, ncol = 3) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL,
         caption = paste0("Dashed line: wave mean.\n", n_note(var))) +
    theme_obj
}
```

# Correlation matrix

```{r}
#| label: fun-corrplot
#| include: false

# Data for the correlation matrices: df_model plus one dummy per income trajectory
# category (the trajectory is nominal, so its categories enter as dummies;
# "Missings" is included as one more category).
traj_cats <- levels(df_model$traj_ingreso)
traj_vars <- setNames(paste0("traj_", seq_along(traj_cats)), traj_cats)

df_cor_base <- df_model %>% ungroup()
for (k in seq_along(traj_cats)) {
  df_cor_base[[traj_vars[k]]] <- as.numeric(df_cor_base$traj_ingreso == traj_cats[k])
}

# One Spearman correlation matrix per wave; ordered factors enter as numeric codes
cor_by_wave <- function(vars) {
  df_cor_base %>%
    select(ola, all_of(names(vars))) %>%
    mutate(across(-ola, ~ as.numeric(.x))) %>%
    group_split(ola, .keep = FALSE) %>%
    map(~ cor(.x, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
}

plot_cor <- function(m, vars, i = NULL, cex = 0.8) {
  rownames(m) <- colnames(m) <- unname(vars)
  corrplot(m,
           method = "color",
           type = "lower",
           diag = FALSE,
           order = "original",
           addCoef.col = "black",
           number.cex = cex,
           number.digits = 2,
           tl.col = "black",
           tl.cex = 0.85,
           tl.srt = 45,
           cl.cex = 0.8,
           col = colorRampPalette(c("#B2182B", "white", "#2166AC"))(200),
           col.lim = c(-1, 1),
           is.corr = TRUE,
           na.label = "-",
           mar = c(4, 0, 1, 0))
  mtext(if (is.null(i)) n_note_pw(names(vars)) else n_note_pw(names(vars), wave_data(i)),
        side = 1, line = 3, cex = 0.8)
}
```

# Modelling

## Subjective social status (WE and BE) and income trajectory

One model per block of status (origin, own and children), without interactions: the income trajectory enters only as a main effect and the random-effects structure is `(1 + ola_num | idencuesta)` (random intercept and random time slope; **no random slope for the WE status**). The reference is **Stable low**.

- **Model 1:** only the trend (linear and quadratic) and the trajectory.
- **Model 2 (base):** adds the controls (ideology, sex, age and university education BE).
- **Models 3 to 5:** to the base model, **each block of status is added separately** (origin, own and children, each with its WE and BE), not cumulatively.

```{r}
#| label: helpers-ingreso-2

# Helpers (same definitions as analysis/previ-sss.qmd). lmerTest is called with
# `::` so that it is not attached and the models above are not affected.
oc    <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
re_A  <- "(1 + ola_num | idencuesta)"
re_B  <- function(s) paste0("(1 + ola_num + ", s, "_we | idencuesta)")

fmt   <- function(x, digits = 3) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, decimal.mark = ",")
star  <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "***", ifelse(p < .01, "**",
                     ifelse(p < .05, "*", ifelse(p < .1, "+", ""))))
p_fmt <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "< 0,001", fmt(p))

cell <- function(m, term) {
  s <- coef(summary(m))
  if (!term %in% rownames(s)) return("")
  paste0(fmt(s[term, 1]), " (", fmt(s[term, 2]), ")", star(s[term, 5]))
}

var_comp <- function(m, what) {
  v <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(m))
  switch(what,
    int   = v$vcov[v$grp == "idencuesta" & v$var1 == "(Intercept)" & is.na(v$var2)],
    time  = v$vcov[v$var1 == "ola_num" & is.na(v$var2) & !is.na(v$var1)],
    sss   = { x <- v$vcov[!is.na(v$var1) & endsWith(v$var1, "_we") & is.na(v$var2)]
              if (length(x)) x else NA_real_ },
    resid = sigma(m)^2)
}

ctrl_t <- c("ola_num", "ola_2", "ideoCenter", "ideoRight",
            "ideoDoes not identify", "sexFemale", "age", "dummy_educ_mean",
            "(Intercept)")   # the intercept goes last
ctrl_l <- c("Tendencia lineal (ola_num)", "Tendencia cuadrática (ola_2)",
            "Ideología: centro", "Ideología: derecha", "Ideología: no se identifica",
            "Mujer", "Edad", "Universitaria BE",
            "Intercepto")

# Table of models with texreg: one row per coefficient ("coef (se)***", single.row = TRUE),
# decimal comma, p-values from lmerTest (Satterthwaite).
#   blocks:     list of blocks (name, terms, labels) that group the rows
#   extra_rows: named list of extra footer rows (one value per model)
make_texreg <- function(models, col_names, blocks, extra_rows = list(), note = "", caption = NULL) {
  terms  <- unlist(lapply(blocks, `[[`, "terms"))
  labels <- unlist(lapply(blocks, `[[`, "labels"))

  # keep only the terms that appear in at least one model (texreg drops the rest)
  present <- sapply(terms, function(t) any(sapply(models, function(m) t %in% rownames(coef(summary(m))))))
  blk_n   <- sapply(blocks, function(b) sum(present[match(b$terms, terms)]))
  groups  <- setNames(split(seq_len(sum(blk_n)), rep(seq_along(blk_n), blk_n)),
                      sapply(blocks, `[[`, "name"))
  groups  <- groups[blk_n > 0]
  coef_map <- as.list(setNames(labels[present], terms[present]))

  gof_rows <- c(
    list("Ajuste singular" = sapply(models, function(m) ifelse(isSingular(m), "sí", "no")),
         "Convergencia"    = sapply(models, function(m)
           ifelse(is.null(m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages), "ok", "advertencia"))),
    extra_rows)

  op <- options(OutDec = ","); on.exit(options(op))
  html <- texreg::htmlreg(
    models,
    custom.model.names = col_names,
    custom.coef.map = coef_map,
    groups = groups,
    custom.gof.rows = gof_rows,
    custom.note = note,
    single.row = TRUE,
    digits = 3,
    stars = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1), symbol = "+",
    include.loglik = FALSE,
    caption = caption, caption.above = TRUE,
    doctype = FALSE, html.tag = FALSE, head.tag = FALSE, body.tag = FALSE,
    center = FALSE, bold = 0)
  # thicker rule on the lines that separate the blocks of the table
  html <- gsub("border-top: 1px solid #000000", "border-top: 2px solid #000000", html, fixed = TRUE)
  for (g in names(groups)) {
    g_esc <- gsub("([][{}()+*^$|\\\\?.])", "\\\\\\1", g)
    html <- sub(paste0('<tr( style="[^"]*")?>(\\s*<td[^>]*>)', g_esc, "</td>"),
                paste0('<tr style="border-top: 2px solid #000000;">\\2', gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", g), "</td>"),
                html)
  }
  knitr::asis_output(html)
}

# Sample: df_model (complete cases in the variables of this section; people without
# a valid income trajectory are in the category "Missings")
d3 <- df_model %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(traj_ingreso = relevel(traj_ingreso, ref = "Stable low"),
         # status: within-person (WE) and between-person (BE, uncentred) effects
         og_we  = ess_og_cwc,    og_be  = ess_og_mean,
         own_we = ess_cwc,       own_be = ess_mean,
         hij_we = ess_hijos_cwc, hij_be = ess_hijos_mean)

tl <- levels(d3$traj_ingreso)   # the reference (Stable low) is the first level

ctrl3 <- "ola_num + ola_2 + ideo + sex + age + dummy_educ_mean"

# Same controls without political ideology (for the optional comparison tables)
ctrl3n  <- "ola_num + ola_2 + sex + age + dummy_educ_mean"
keep_n  <- !ctrl_t %in% c("ideoCenter", "ideoRight", "ideoDoes not identify")
ctrl_tn <- ctrl_t[keep_n]
ctrl_ln <- ctrl_l[keep_n]

fit3 <- function(rhs, re = re_A, dat = d3) {
  lmerTest::lmer(as.formula(paste("mjp_index ~", rhs, "+", re)),
                 data = dat, REML = FALSE, control = oc)
}
```

## Income trajectory × subjective social status (WE and BE)

One model per status (origin, own and children). Each model includes the controls, the six main effects of status, the income trajectory and the interaction of the trajectory with the **WE** and the **BE** of that column's status. The **slope of the interacted WE status is random**: `(1 + ola_num + X_we | idencuesta)`. Each likelihood-ratio test compares the model with interactions against a base model with the same random slope but no interactions.

```{r}
#| label: models-ingreso-2

ss3   <- c(Origen = "og", Propio = "own", Hijos = "hij")
main3 <- "og_we + og_be + own_we + own_be + hij_we + hij_be + traj_ingreso"

base_A3 <- fit3(paste(ctrl3, "+", main3))   # sin pendiente aleatoria de SSS

T2    <- list()
lrt2  <- list()

for (s in ss3) {
  int_we <- paste0(s, "_we:traj_ingreso")
  int_be <- paste0(s, "_be:traj_ingreso")
  rs     <- re_B(s)

  b_rs   <- fit3(paste(ctrl3, "+", main3), rs)                                  # base con la misma pendiente aleatoria
  T2[[s]] <- fit3(paste(ctrl3, "+", main3, "+", int_we, "+", int_be), rs)
  m_we   <- fit3(paste(ctrl3, "+", main3, "+", int_we), rs)

  lrt2[[s]] <- c(
    conj = anova(b_rs, T2[[s]])$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
    we   = anova(b_rs, m_we)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
    rs   = anova(base_A3, b_rs)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
}
```

```{r}
#| label: blocks-ingreso-2

sss3_t <- c("og_we", "og_be", "own_we", "own_be", "hij_we", "hij_be")
sss3_l <- c("Origen WE", "Origen BE", "Propio WE", "Propio BE", "Hijos WE", "Hijos BE")

traj_t <- paste0("traj_ingreso", tl[-1])

int3_t <- int3_l <- character()
for (s in ss3) {
  etq <- names(ss3)[ss3 == s]
  int3_t <- c(int3_t, paste0(s, "_we:traj_ingreso", tl[-1]), paste0(s, "_be:traj_ingreso", tl[-1]))
  int3_l <- c(int3_l, paste0(etq, " WE × ", tl[-1]), paste0(etq, " BE × ", tl[-1]))
}

blocks_ing2 <- list(
  list(name = "Efectos principales de estatus", terms = sss3_t, labels = sss3_l),
  list(name = "Trayectoria de ingreso (ref.: Stable low)", terms = traj_t, labels = tl[-1]),
  list(name = "Interacciones trayectoria × estatus", terms = int3_t, labels = int3_l),
  list(name = "Controles", terms = ctrl_t, labels = ctrl_l))   # controls at the end

note_ing2 <- paste("Coeficientes con errores estándar entre paréntesis.",
                   "*** p < 0,001; ** p < 0,01; * p < 0,05; + p < 0,1.",
                   "Los coeficientes de interacción son diferencias respecto de Stable low;",
                   "la pendiente de cada trayectoria es el efecto principal más su interacción.",
                   "Los efectos principales de cada trayectoria se leen con los efectos BE en 0,",
                   "un valor que casi nadie tiene, y no son interpretables por sí solos.",
                   "Las categorías Low -> Top y Top -> Low tienen muy pocas personas.",
                   "Missings agrupa a quienes no tienen trayectoria de ingreso válida.")
```

```{r}
           c("Origen × Trayectoria", "Propio × Trayectoria", "Hijos × Trayectoria"),
           blocks_ing2,
           extra_rows = list(
             "LRT interacción WE + BE (p)" = sapply(ss3, function(s) p_fmt(lrt2[[s]]["conj"])),
             "LRT interacción solo WE (p)" = sapply(ss3, function(s) p_fmt(lrt2[[s]]["we"])),
             "LRT pendiente aleatoria vs. sin ella (p)" = sapply(ss3, function(s) p_fmt(lrt2[[s]]["rs"]))),
           note = note_ing2,
           caption = "Trayectoria de ingreso × estatus subjetivo (índice MJP), con pendiente aleatoria del estatus WE interactuado")
```

## Subjective mobility and income trajectory

Same structure as the previous section, but the subjective social status is replaced by the subjective mobility **children - origin** (`mov_exp_og`), decomposed into its within-person (WE) and between-person (BE, uncentred) components. There are no interactions and the random-effects structure is `(1 + ola_num | idencuesta)` (no random slope for the WE mobility). The reference is **Stable low**.

- **Model 1:** only the trend (linear and quadratic) and the trajectory.
- **Model 2 (base):** adds the controls (ideology, sex, age and university education BE).
- **Model 3:** adds the mobility WE and BE to the base model.

```{r}
#| label: models-ingreso-mov

rhs_m <- list(tiempo = "ola_num + ola_2",
              base   = ctrl3,
              mov    = paste(ctrl3, "+ mov_exp_og_cwc + mov_exp_og_mean"))

Tm  <- lapply(rhs_m, function(r) fit3(paste(r, "+ traj_ingreso")))   # with trajectory
Tmr <- lapply(rhs_m, fit3)                                           # without trajectory

lrt_bloque_m <- c("", "", p_fmt(anova(Tm$base, Tm$mov)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]))
lrt_traj_m   <- sapply(names(Tm), function(k)
  p_fmt(anova(Tmr[[k]], Tm[[k]])$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]))
```

```{r}
#| label: blocks-ingreso-mov

blocks_ingm <- list(
  list(name = "Movilidad subjetiva: hijos - origen", terms = c("mov_exp_og_cwc", "mov_exp_og_mean"),
       labels = c("Movilidad WE", "Movilidad BE")),
  blocks_ing1[[2]],   # trajectory
  blocks_ing1[[3]])   # controls

note_ingm <- paste("Coeficientes con errores estándar entre paréntesis.",
                   "*** p < 0,001; ** p < 0,01; * p < 0,05; + p < 0,1.",
                   "Referencia de la trayectoria: Stable low. Efectos BE sin centrar.",
                   "Missings agrupa a quienes no tienen trayectoria de ingreso válida.",
                   "'LRT movilidad' compara el Modelo 3 contra el Modelo 2;",
                   "'LRT trayectorias' compara cada modelo contra el mismo modelo sin las trayectorias.")
```

```{r}

make_texreg(unname(Tm),
           c("Modelo 1: solo tiempo", "Modelo 2: base", "Modelo 3: + Movilidad"),

                             "LRT trayectorias (p)" = lrt_traj_m),

           caption = "Trayectoria de ingreso y preferencias de justicia de mercado (índice MJP), con controles y movilidad subjetiva (hijos - origen)")
```

## Subjective mobility x income trajectory

Same structure as the *Income trajectory × subjective social status* section, but the subjective social status is replaced by the subjective mobility **children - origin** (`mov_exp_og`, WE and BE). The model includes the controls, the mobility main effects (WE and BE), the income trajectory and the interaction of the trajectory with the mobility **WE** and **BE**. The **slope of the mobility WE is random**: `(1 + ola_num + mov_exp_og_cwc | idencuesta)`. Each likelihood-ratio test compares the model with interactions against a base model with the same random slope but no interactions.

```{r}
#| label: models-ingreso-mov-int

mv_we <- "mov_exp_og_cwc"
mv_be <- "mov_exp_og_mean"
main_m <- paste(mv_we, "+", mv_be, "+ traj_ingreso")
re_Bm  <- paste0("(1 + ola_num + ", mv_we, " | idencuesta)")

int_we_m <- paste0(mv_we, ":traj_ingreso")
int_be_m <- paste0(mv_be, ":traj_ingreso")

base_Am <- fit3(paste(ctrl3, "+", main_m))                 # without random slope of mobility
b_rsm   <- fit3(paste(ctrl3, "+", main_m), re_Bm)          # base with the same random slope
Tmi     <- fit3(paste(ctrl3, "+", main_m, "+", int_we_m, "+", int_be_m), re_Bm)
m_wem   <- fit3(paste(ctrl3, "+", main_m, "+", int_we_m), re_Bm)

lrt_mi <- c(
  conj = anova(b_rsm, Tmi)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
  we   = anova(b_rsm, m_wem)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
  rs   = anova(base_Am, b_rsm)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
```

```{r}
#| label: blocks-ingreso-mov-int

blocks_ingmi <- list(
  list(name = "Movilidad subjetiva: hijos - origen", terms = c(mv_we, mv_be),
       labels = c("Movilidad WE", "Movilidad BE")),
  blocks_ing2[[2]],   # trajectory
  list(name = "Interacciones trayectoria × movilidad",
       terms  = c(paste0(int_we_m, tl[-1]), paste0(int_be_m, tl[-1])),
       labels = c(paste0("Movilidad WE × ", tl[-1]), paste0("Movilidad BE × ", tl[-1]))),
  blocks_ing2[[4]])   # controls
```

```{r}
             "LRT interacción solo WE (p)" = p_fmt(lrt_mi["we"]),
```
